details:
You should supply the depth texture when rendering Main Camera view so that any shader would be able to access it without having to go in roundabout ways and forcing it on via directional lights.

Depth texture is already rendered for depth pre-passes and umbra comparison steps, and since it is rendered at native resolution, it *can* be kept for compositor/2000+ steps.

Current workaround for getting it requires there to be an active directional light with shadowcasting enabled, but this has significant enough overhead on its own: shadowcaster may be inexpensive on its own, but it very quickly stacks up, as we render into cascades for everything that's visible.

Modern shaders also tend to do some runtime branch optimisations to cut out excess instructions, one such branch is used when rendering directional lights in FWDBASE, along the lines of:

bool dirLightPresent = any(_WorldSpaceLightPos0.xyz);

These fail when an unnecessary directional light is introduced, but has no visual effect: this is especially important with complex shading models like PBR, even if DFG is precomputed, as you're introducing a TDR where it can be avoided (analytical DFG aside).

Moreover, by removing lights from this equation entirely we can cut out a costly entity evaluation loop.

It is also crucial to note that every additional directional light will be rendered in FWDADD pass for every entity visible, as it has no attenuation, and there is no convenient way to designate an existing light source as a "singleton" depth emitter, outside of manual coordination. This is often an issue when considering more involved avatars or large scale events. It'd be nice to have UGC freedoms without fearing to cause or even causing performance hits. I see more and more avatars use depth buffer features, and you can do your part to help with performance.

In general, such basic feature should be enabled by default since you're allowing arbitrary shader code to be ran. You could allow it to be disabled on an individual world basis, per decision of the creator, but edge cases where it wouldn't be desirable are few and far between.
title: Supply the depth texture on Main Camera
